pairs.why: A has slightly firmer shading and crisper fold edges, so it reads less like soft matte clay and more like the cleanly rendered real cards.
A's coat has stronger light-to-shadow modelling and more defined lapels, while B is flatter and more clay-like.
A shows a clearly built hanger-on-hook setup and richer shading, while B's coat is slightly flatter and its hanging is less clear.
The two are nearly equal; A has slightly more contrast and crisper button and pocket detail, which is closer to the real cards' defined rendering.
B has slightly crisper edges, stronger directional light and a cleanly hooked hanger, while A is a bit softer and mushier.
A has stronger shading and a clearer cast shadow, which gives it more of the crisp volume of the real cards than B's softer, flatter clay finish.
A is crisper with clearer folds and button detail, while B's hook and hanger link is slightly muddled and its surface is softer.
A has warmer, richer lighting and clearer volume on a properly hung hanger, while B is a bit flatter and its coat drapes oddly straight over the hook.
